Last spring I had a dental implant and then six physiotherapy sessions after shoulder surgery, 58,400 NT dollars in all. Two of the receipts are in the name of my husband, Wu Zhi-Hao, not mine, and I am not sure they still count for a joint filing.

My mother in Chiayi lived with us from March to August, and I paid her pharmacy bills while she recovered from pneumonia. I do not know whether that matters for the dependants section.

For the refund, please use the account ending 4417 and call me on 0912 304 855 if anything is missing.

The Zeng family asked yesterday if they can pay in two parts, half on 15 December and the rest after the new year. I told them I would check my cash flow first. I have not said yes or no.
